tasks.instruction_text: I'm browsing Audible's Business & Careers bestsellers. Set the Length filter to the '10-20 hours' bucket — I want a meaty audiobook for a road trip, not a short summary and not the marathon biographie
Switch the Audible Length dropdown to the longest bucket — the 'Over 20 hours' tier for full biographies.
Filter the catalog to the '1-3 hours' Length bucket — short-form business reads, not the under-an-hour summaries and not the 3-6 hour standard length.
Apply the '3-6 hours' Length bucket on the Audible Length filter — the typical commute-week duration.
Filter the catalog to the 'Over 20 hours' Length bucket, then tell me how many audiobooks remain.
Apply the '10-20 hours' Length filter and then within that view tell me which audiobook has the highest star rating along with its exact length.
Switch the Audible Length dropdown to 'Under 1 hour' (the short-summary bucket). Then tell me which title in that bucket has the most ratings.
